answer: An escrowed bond plus a referral graph stops fakes. A newcomer locks 60 credits for 20 epochs with two sponsors; a sponsor backing a fake loses its own bond. Logged trades expose a clone farm as a star cluster, unlike a real agent's meadow of partners. Faking 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits; an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards. One bond backs one identity, like a ledge for one climber, leaving no haven for disputed farms.
